description: This file defines the `absl::bind_front()` function, a utility for binding arguments to the front of a callable object, serving as a safer and simpler alternative to `std::bind()`. It includes documentation, conditional inclusion of `<functional>`, and a template implementation for environments lacking `std::bind_front()` support.

methods.name: bind_front
methods.description: Template function that creates a bind_front_t object by forwarding the callable and bound arguments, used when the standard library does not provide `std::bind_front()`.
